approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Make a square classic internet cat meme using the supplied cat photograph. Preserve the original surprised cat, face, and couch photo as closely as possible. Add exactly this top caption: "WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY" and exactly this bottom caption: "BUT IT'S ONLY TUESDAY". Both captions must be very large bold condensed uppercase white letters with thick black outlines, classic Impact meme typography, centered, wrapped into two lines if needed to fit. Place the top text along the very top edge above the cat's eyes, and bottom text along the bottom edge below the cat's face. Keep both cat eyes completely clear and unobstructed. All text must be fully visible within the square with small safe margins. No other text.
